description: Source code for a QR Code generator library supporting Python 2 and 3, including classes for QR code and data segments, with methods for encoding text, binary data, and segments, as well as error correction and rendering functions.

classes.name: QrCode
classes.description: Represents an immutable QR code grid supporting all versions and error correction levels, with methods for encoding, rendering, and error correction.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Represents a data segment to be encoded in a QR code, supporting various encoding modes and segment creation methods.

classes.name: _ReedSolomonGenerator
classes.description: Computes Reed-Solomon error correction codewords for data blocks in QR codes.

classes.name: _BitBuffer
classes.description: A helper class for appending bits and packing them into bytes.

methods.name: encode_text
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode text string into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encode_binary
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a QR code with specified error correction level.

methods.name: encode_segments
methods.description: Encodes data segments with custom parameters, automatically choosing minimal version and applying error correction.

methods.name: make_bytes
methods.description: Creates a data segment from binary data in byte mode.

methods.name: make_numeric
methods.description: Creates a data segment from numeric string.

methods.name: make_alphanumeric
methods.description: Creates a data segment from alphanumeric string.

methods.name: make_segments
methods.description: Creates segments from Unicode text, choosing optimal encoding modes.

methods.name: make_eci
methods.description: Creates a segment for Extended Channel Interpretation.
